subject: POC: prompt feed submission readiness checklist & evaluation sequencing (Cloudbridge)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia@cloudbridge.ai>, Devon Lee <devon@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC: prompt feed submission readiness checklist & next steps

Hi Alicia / Devon — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap + concrete next steps so we can keep momentum on the POC intake: 

Summary of agreed success criteria (please confirm):
- End-to-end accuracy: Redwood-generated responses meet Cloudbridge internal rubric >= 85% on the sampled eval set.
- Latency: median generation latency < 350ms for interactive scenarios at test concurrency.
- Cost target: baseline tokens/unit cost under the threshold we discussed (Priya will model after we have prompt distribution).
- Integration: straightforward S3 + pre-signed upload for prompt/log delivery and ability for Cloudbridge to run local QA before ingestion.

Prompt/log deliverable details we need from you:
- Preferred format: CSV or newline-delimited JSON. We prefer CSV using the attached template (prompt_template.csv). Required columns: prompt_id, user_query, expected_answer, timestamp_utc, channel, anonymized_user_id, metadata_tags. Optional: score_label, context_snippet.
- Minimum sample: 500 sample prompts to start (we'll run quick smoke eval). Target full set: 2,500–3,000 prompts for final evaluation.
- PII: please anonymize PII before upload; if you have redaction constraints we can accept hashed identifiers.
- Delivery window: can you provide the 500-sample by next Friday (2027-06-25) and full set within 3 weeks?

Evaluation & logistics (high level):
- Ingest -> QA -> scoring by Redwood eval harness using the attached evaluation_rubric.md.
- We will return a report showing top failure modes, token cost estimates, and recommended quantization/batching profiles to hit your latency/cost targets.

Ownership:
- Cloudbridge delivery lead: Alicia Chen (external)
- Redwood onboarding: Monica Patel (CS) — primary contact for S3 ingestion & data checks
- Redwood AE: Ben Carter — contract/PO and commercial items

Next steps for you: share a writeable S3 bucket or request a pre-signed upload link, and upload the sample CSV (cloudbridge_sample_prompts.csv) when ready. If you need us to run additional anonymization, let us know and we can scope it.

Attachments: prompt_template.csv (CSV template), evaluation_rubric.md (scoring matrix)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if any of this needs clarification.

—
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Alicia Chen <alicia@cloudbridge.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Lee <devon@cloudbridge.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 19:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: prompt feed submission readiness checklist & next steps

Thanks Priya — this is perfect, appreciate the clear checklist. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- PII / anonymization: we will strip direct identifiers and replace with hashed user IDs; we have a small amount of free-text context that may contain names, we can either scrub or provide a separate consent-bucket. Which do you prefer for evaluation?
- Sample cadence: we can deliver the requested 500-sample subset by 2027-06-25. Full set (~3k) ready by 2027-07-09.
- File format: CSV works; we'll follow the template. Sending a small sample now (attached) so you can sanity-check ingest.

Attachment: cloudbridge_sample_prompts.csv (snippet)

On scoring: can you confirm whether the rubric supports both free-text exact-match tolerance and categorical label matching? Our team will include expected_answer_text and an intent_label column.

If helpful we'll accept a short call Monday to sync on the S3 upload approach (we have an infosec checklist we might need to run by you).

Best,
Alicia
Director of Data Science | Cloudbridge Analytics
alicia@cloudbridge.ai

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia@cloudbridge.ai>, Devon Lee <devon@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: prompt feed submission readiness checklist & next steps

Great — thanks for the quick reply and sample upload. A few notes/addressing your questions: 

1) PII / redaction: Either approach works. For speed, please provide the scrubbed CSV (no direct identifiers) and include a small consent-bucket (separate file) if you want us to evaluate on original context. If Cloudbridge cannot remove certain tokens, flag them in metadata_tags and we'll treat them as excluded for metric calculations.

2) Scoring support: Yes — evaluation_rubric.md supports mixed-mode scoring:
  - Free-text responses: normalized token overlap + semantic similarity threshold.
  - Categorical/intent labels: exact-match + confusion matrix export.
  - We will map intent_label -> expected_category and produce per-intent precision/recall numbers.

3) Required columns (final): prompt_id, user_query, expected_answer, intent_label, timestamp_utc, anonymized_user_id, metadata_tags. If you have confidence scores you can include expected_confidence.

4) Timeline we propose (detailed):
  - 2027-06-25: receive 500-sample CSV (smoke ingestion)
  - 2027-06-26 to 2027-06-30: Redwood ingest + QC + preliminary report
  - 2027-07-09: receive full ~3k set
  - 2027-07-10 to 2027-07-18: full evaluation run + final report + recommendations

5) Access / upload: we can provide a pre-signed S3 upload link with server-side encryption. I'll drop upload instructions (s3_upload_instructions.md) and a pre-signed URL in a secure Hub link once you confirm the delivery window.

Owners recap: Monica will own ingestion and QC (onboarding@redwood.ai) — she will reach out with the ingestion checklist and runbook. Ben will track procurement/PO items.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/14572

Expect a separate email from Monica with the S3 link and ingestion checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to the sample.

—
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: prompt feed submission readiness checklist & next steps

>
> 4) Timeline we propose (detailed):

>   - 2027-06-26 to 2027-06-30: Redwood ingest + QC + preliminary report

Action items for Redwood (assigned):
- Monica: prepare ingestion playbook and runbook; create pre-signed S3 upload and verify bucket policy (ETA: 2027-06-20 EOD). Attachment: s3_upload_instructions.md
- Monica: run a quick schema check on the sample Alicia uploaded; report any column mismatches by Monday morning.
- Ben: confirm commercial terms/PO timeline with Alicia (Ben to follow up in parallel).

I'll start the onboarding ticket in our internal tracker and will create a shared folder for logs/reports (link to be posted in the ticket). If any of you have constraints around encryption or VPC-only uploads, flag now and I will raise with infra.
